prompt:
Flat vector logo mark as a clean SVG, square viewBox 0 0 512 512, transparent background. Use only flat solid fills with exactly these colours: #8A8D91, #5F6267, #1C1C1E, #D5D7DA, #F2B705, #FFF1C9. No gradients, no filters, no shadows, no opacity, no strokes thinner than 6 units, no <text> elements: every symbol is drawn as <path> shapes.

Subject: a rotary slide-projector tray seen exactly from above that clearly says "Pi" and "Gemini". Build it in this order:
1. Tray body: one perfectly circular disc in #8A8D91, centred exactly at (256, 256), diameter 450.
2. Moulded rim: a flat ring in #5F6267 along the disc's outer edge, about 12 units wide.
3. Centre: a large bold mathematical pi symbol π in #1C1C1E, about one third of the disc's width, exactly centred: a thick horizontal top bar and two thick legs, the right leg ending in a small outward curl, rounded ends. Single solid shape, never built from blocks.
4. Seven slide mounts on a ring around the π, at the 45, 90, 135, 180, 225, 270 and 315 degree positions (clockwise from 12 o'clock). Each mount is a 35mm slide: a square #1C1C1E frame with a landscape 3:2 window in #D5D7DA. Each mount is rotated to its own angle so the long side of its window is tangent to the ring, like slots in a carousel tray. All seven are identical apart from rotation.
5. The projector gate at the 0 degree position, 12 o'clock: one upright slide about 1.7 times larger than the other mounts, frame #F2B705, with a SQUARE window #FFF1C9 (square, not landscape). Inside that square window, filling about 80% of its height, the Gemini zodiac sign ♊ in #1C1C1E drawn tall and narrow: two bold vertical stems whose height is at least 1.5 times the gap between them, a deep arc across the top and a deep arc across the bottom whose ends run past the stems, stroke weight about 60% of the π stem. It must read as ♊, two pillars, never as a box, as ¤, or as the Roman numeral II.

The amber gate slide is the only warm element and the π is the only large dark shape. Keep everything symmetric about the vertical axis except the rotation of the mounts. Do not use a four-pointed sparkle or star, do not imitate any existing company logo.
